method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied (the employee), with an employer seat layer, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and 2026-10-21; no REFUSE (gaps answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Fringe Benefits Tax Assessment Act 1986, Compilation No. 97, compilation date 1 July 2026 (includes amendments up to Act No. 49, 2026; register id C2026C00332), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A03280.txt, with the formulas of ss 5B(1B), 5B(1C), 9(1) and 135P(2) from the sidecar ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A03280.formulas.md (transcribed 2026-10-23 from the authorised Word rendering), and of ss 10(2), 11(1A), (1), (1AA), (1B), (2), 12(1), 135Q(4) and 136(1) business use percentage from the same sidecar's entries recovered 2026-10-24; and the rate of tax from the Fringe Benefits Tax Act 1986, Compilation No. 9 (19 June 2018), as deposited at ../../../fringe-benefits-tax-act-1986/registers/source-bundle/C2004A03281.txt (ss 6, 6A). The benchmark interest rate and the GST rate are inputs.

checks.command: l4 run fbtaa-employee.l4 ; l4 run fbtaa-seat-employer.l4 ; l4 run fbtaa-cases-employee.l4 ; l4 run fbtaa-cases-employer.l4 ; l4 run fbtaa-formulas.l4 ; l4 run fbtaa-cases-formulas.l4
checks.result: 84 assertions satisfied (42 employee, 20 employer, 22 formulas), 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Employee: fringe benefit (s 136(1), in outline), exemptions for zero or low emissions cars (s 8A), work related items (s 58X), minor benefits (s 58P), loans (s 17(1), (3)); taxable value of a car by the statutory formula (s 9) and of a loan (s 18); reportable fringe benefits amount and total (ss 135N, 135P) with the rate (FBT Act ss 6, 6A). Employer: fringe benefits taxable amount (s 5B(1A)-(1C)), the tax (s 66, FBT Act s 6), return and payment dates (ss 68, 90), and mirror questions. Out: other benefit types and valuation methods, s 8, s 10, ss 11-13, s 17(2), (4), otherwise deductible rules, other exemptions and reductions, s 65J, s 5B(1D)-(1M), s 135G, s 135Q and years before 1 April 2015 (`not covered`), administration. Added 2026-10-24 (fbtaa-formulas.l4): s 135Q (reportable amount for employees of s 57A and s 58 employers), s 10(1)-(3)(a), (5) cost basis with ss 11, 12 and the s 136(1) business use percentage.
seat: the employee receiving a benefit; and, in fbtaa-seat-employer.l4, the employer who pays the tax
